task: DESIGN-ONLY packet: propose the ADR closing P7's final remaining gate (composed-tape verification), per RE-ENTRY.md's own stated next-gate ordering. No production code, tests, or RED/GREEN were run; no merge occurred.
proposal: Re-verifies the 2026-09-16 architecture gate (evidence 0176: a ReplayRun consumer needed to both read an outer-manifest root via legacy v1 open_capture/VerifiedCapture, single-CAPTURED, AND be a second consumer of the data root via P4 commit_p4_batch multi-consumer, which run-identity exclusivity then forbade mixing in one run) against the CURRENT dskit/pipeline/trust.py, not by assumption. Finds gate 0176 resolvable by direct reading: (1) ADR-0129's accessor (CapturedAuthorizationRecord.read_member_bytes / .lifecycle_captured_receipt_sha256, trust.py:4824-4898, backed by _LifecycleAuthorizationLedger.read_p4_member/p4_receipt_digest, trust.py:5305-5343) is fully merged and applies to any committed P4 capture, fixed or dynamic; (2) ADR-0143/0144's dynamic authority already reaches a real authorize_capture_set -> CAPTURED admission end-to-end, exercised by passing tests (tests/pipeline/test_captured_authorization.py: _adr143_issued_case, _adr144_document_and_captures, _adr144_admission_ref, test_adr144_dynamic_authorize_capture_set_reaches_genuine_captured_admission); (3) run-identity exclusivity (commit_legacy_capture trust.py:5177, commit_p4_batch trust.py:5437) is a per-ledger-instance invariant, not process-global -- each authority instance owns its own _LifecycleAuthorizationLedger (ADR-0143 Decision point 3), and ADR-0144's own Non-goals explicitly disclaim any cross-instance run-identity check. ADR-0146 adopts the smaller of two independently sufficient resolutions: applying ADR-0129's accessor to a SINGLE dynamic-authority CAPTURED admission supplies both member bytes and a receipt digest from the SAME capture, eliminating the need for a second (legacy) capture leg entirely -- so there is nothing left to mix, irrespective of the per-ledger argument. The alternative the task explicitly asked to be considered (mixing the dynamic authority for one leg and legacy v1 for a separately-published outer-manifest leg) is recorded as also conflict-free by the per-ledger argument, but NOT adopted, because it would require a new, unbuilt capability -- publishing a brand-new root outside the fixed P4 corpus and outside the dynamic authority's closed 12-reference graph (ADR-0142) -- reopening exactly the kind of unbounded scope that produced three failed whole-composition Phase 0 cycles on the original ADR-0127 Decision.2 design (evidence 0179). ADR-0146 therefore formally narrows ADR-0127 Decision.2: the 'outer manifest' (CapturedReplayTape.v1) is constructed and default-deny verified IN the consuming process from bytes resolved out of the same data capture, never itself republished as a second captured root; ReplayTapeManifestProducer/ReplayTapeManifestCapture as separately-published entities (never implemented in code -- confirmed by direct search) are retired from the plan. The proposed design reuses ONLY already-merged, already-tested symbols (CapturedAuthorizationRecord's ADR-0129 accessor, the dynamic authority's ADR-0143/0144 fixtures, CapturedReplayTape._build/canonical_bytes/parse and verify_causal_order from ADR-0145, and its existing envelope-shape fixture builder in tests/production/test_event_envelope_causal_order.py) and adds NO new function or class to trust.py or production/bundles.py -- the entire deliverable is new fixture-only integration test code (recommended placement: appended to tests/pipeline/test_captured_authorization.py, a Phase 0 pin) proving one straight-line synthetic tape: one dynamic-authority CAPTURED admission -> resolved roster + raw-event member bytes -> projected dskit.event-envelope/v2 objects -> a built-and-reparsed CapturedReplayTape -> verify_causal_order, plus at least one negative-family case proving the checks are live against resolved, not fixture-literal, bytes.
scope: Design proposal only: ADR-0146 appended to docs/architecture/decision-log.md and this evidence file. No production code, pipeline code, or test file was written or edited. No RED/GREEN. No merge.
non_goals: Wiring ReplayRun.run() into the pipeline execution engine (a distinct, larger capability -- delivering a live CapturedAuthorizationRecord/session to any node's run(ctx, inputs) -- that exists for no node today, not only ReplayRun); a second manifest-publish capability or any extension to the dynamic authority's closed 12-reference graph; exercising ADR-0128 multi-consumer capture as a requirement (available, not required); resurrecting ADR-0130's undelivered SourceRosterCapture.v1/RawEventDatasetCapture.v1/DatasetCaptureAuthorization.v1 broker; the full master F3 EventEnvelope.v2 lane; real replay, backtest, paper or live operation; Packet 8 durable consume-once (F5A-R23); deployment. Any edit to trust.py's dynamic P4 authority, the five ADR-0143 forbidden-legacy symbols, or ADR-0144's dynamic-dispatch code.
